pasteDecisions.alreadyLinkedSelection: not wrapped; falls through to the default replace
pasteDecisions.nonUrl: falls through to the default replace
pasteDecisions.selectionSpanningBlocks: not wrapped; a link cannot span two blocks
pasteDecisions.urlDefinition: a single whitespace-free token with an explicit scheme that passes the http/https/mailto allowlist

rows.note: Typing the closing character steps past the auto-inserted one instead of duplicating it.
The recorded position is mapped through the keystrokes in between, so `(xyz)` does not become `(xyz))`.
Nested pairs step over innermost first.
A symmetric delimiter never pairs after a word character, or typing English produces `don''t`.
A symmetric delimiter never pairs after the same delimiter, which is what keeps ``` from becoming ````.
Stepping over the auto-inserted backtick re-triggers the input rules, so the shipped inline-code rule still fires.
